title: Weak Limits of Discrete Wave-Turbulence Spectra
exact_target: Under the stated damping, forcing and box scalings, does the discrete averaged wave spectrum converge to the damped-driven kinetic equation?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002924 (OWR-13855-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Dynamische Systeme (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/34, pp. 1937--1988. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 24.
Kuksin--Maiocchi, derivation of a wave kinetic equation (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Grande--Hani, rigorous damped-driven wave turbulence (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The extraction omits the original nonlinear Schrödinger equation, collision integral and test-function topology. Those are source-defined parts of the target; no alternative kinetic equation is supplied here.
